name: 3 terminal tools
title: 3 free terminal tools: zoxide, Atuin, lazygit
caption:
3 free terminal tools I'd install on day one 🖥️

① zoxide: a smarter cd that remembers the folders you use most (z api → ~/code/clients/acme/api)
② Atuin: your shell history in a searchable SQLite database, with exit code, duration and time for every command
③ lazygit: a terminal UI for git. Stage single lines, cherry-pick and rebase without the arcane commands

All three are open source. brew install zoxide atuin lazygit

Comment "SHELL" and I'll DM you all three links 🔗
